description: A Coral Bleaching Story With an Unknown Ending is a case study listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by PacificIslandsClimate.org; American Samoa Coral Reef Advisory Group; NOAA Coral Reef Watch. Changing ocean conditions pose an increasing threat to the health and resilience of coral reefs. Across the two Samoas (American Samoa and the Independent State of Samoa) people are planning to protect these important ecosystems. Coverage: the United States (2016). The listed link gives the documented application. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the cited source documents and the outcomes reported were not checked, and no model or dataset used was verified. It can support comparison with similar adaptation projects and planning precedents. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
